title: Patch: every Meditative Alt art somewhere else: the same subject in a new place, time or moment, one brief per card
notes: Meditative's Alt art pass (#3330, on #3401's scenes). Every Meditative card offered Alt art, 54 of them, now draws an alt scene recipe of its own from a brief per card (R3404000): its subject restaged in another place, time or moment, under a sky sharing no colour with its normal picture's and a new camera (a close-up, a wide or distant view, or one from above or below), where Alt art had redrawn the normal ink-wash scene from another seed. A figure keeps the normal picture's person, and every picture keeps Meditative's one red seal. Every Alt art level draws the one alt picture, base and Radiant; each clears its rarity's detail floor and the byte ceiling, and in a real browser changes at least 60% of the normal window's sampled points (ALT_PICTURE_CHANGE_MIN). Repaints keep the normal recipe. The scene kit gains an oar, a sofa and a tower crane. How cards look only: nothing plays differently.

player.title: Every Meditative Alt art restaged
changes: Every Meditative card's Alt art now shows its subject somewhere else, a new place, time or moment, clearly apart from its normal art.
